body.zh: 酸与碳酸氢盐反应持续放出二氧化碳。不连接导管时气体直接逸散到空气中；接上导管通入倒置的集气瓶，气体在瓶内累积、把水排开——这就是排水集气法。
body.en: Acid plus bicarbonate releases CO₂ continuously. Without tubing the gas escapes; with a delivery tube into an inverted cylinder, gas accumulates and displaces the water — collection over water.

misconception.zh: 冒泡停止不一定是装置“坏了”，更可能是反应物之一已经耗尽。
misconception.en: When bubbling stops the apparatus is rarely 'broken' — more often one reactant is simply exhausted.
